verdict.line: You lose if he hits level 6 at even health and forces Realm of Death on his terms; you win if you all-in with E-Q-W between levels 3-5 or hold a clear HP lead before he can duel you.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser's R (Realm of Death) turns any fight after level 6 into an isolated 1v1 decided almost entirely by HP% and items at the moment it's cast, with no flash, no ally peel, and no minion aggro to lean on. That means Darius's whole lane plan is to win the tempo race before 6, since his E (Apprehend) into Q (Decimate) into W (Crippling Strike) combo is the strongest all-in either laner has pre-6. Once both have their ultimates, Darius only wants to re-engage when he's already ahead on health, because he brings his own duel-closer in R (Noxian Guillotine).

theirWindow.when: Level 6+ with health bars roughly even
theirWindow.what: Stay outside his E (Death's Grasp) and R cast range when he's walking up looking for a fight — if he lands R (Realm of Death) at even HP it's a coinflip you don't need to give him. Let a wave crash or take a tower shot first so you enter any duel ahead.

yourWindow.what: Full commit E into Q into W: Apprehend pulls him in and shreds his armor, Decimate's outer rim heals you back, and Crippling Strike's slow plus your stacked Hemorrhage true damage closes the trade fast. This is the one window where he has no duel button to bail him out.

start.why: The AD, health, and lifesteal help you win extended trades and offset the chip damage from his W (Siphon of Destruction) poke.

boots.why: Magic resist and tenacity blunt his AP damage and the slow from E (Death's Grasp), keeping you able to close the gap.

core.why: Attack speed, damage, and the sheen proc make your W-empowered auto and passive stacking hit far harder in the all-in.
Armor shred stacks with your E's own armor reduction, letting your auto-attacks and R execute through his magic-resist-heavy build.
The health and tenacity-adjacent survivability keep you alive through his W burst so you can land the killing blow first.

situational.when: he's snowballing and forcing realm of death duels while ahead
his w poke and auto trades chip you down before you can reach 6
you want extra magic resist and amplified healing off your passive and ult

runes.keystoneWhy: Fights with Morde run long rather than ending in one burst window, and Conqueror's stacking damage and healing reward you for staying in extended trades where your passive and W keep landing.

summoners.why: Ghost gives you the stick to actually land Apprehend and finish with Guillotine on a champion whose only real disengage is walking away, and helps you close distance before he can settle into R range.

playing.title: Win the pre-6 all-in
playing.detail: Land your E-Q-W combo between levels 3-5 while he has no duel button. Don't let him hit level 6 at even health.

playing.title: Track his Darkness Rise stacks
playing.detail: At 2 stacks his next spell or auto is empowered with bonus magic damage. Dodge or juke the proc instead of eating it in a trade.

playing.title: Respect R once he's 6
playing.detail: Don't walk into E (Death's Grasp) or R range unless you're clearly ahead on HP%. A forced duel at even health is a fight you don't need to take.

playing.title: Fight near minions, not alone
playing.detail: His Q (Obliterate) deals bonus damage to isolated targets, so pick fights near a wave or camp early to blunt that burst.

playing.title: Hold E for the pull, not chip poke
playing.detail: Apprehend's armor shred and pull is your engage tool. Save it until you can immediately follow with W's slow so he can't walk out.

playing.title: Buy Guardian Angel if he's snowballing
playing.detail: If he's ahead and forcing early duels, GA can revive mid-fight and flip a losing Realm of Death into a win.

playing.title: Short-trade and freeze under 6
playing.detail: If a clean all-in isn't there, play a tight freeze near your tower. His W poke burns mana and he has no reliable disengage besides walking away.

brief.patchCaveat: Build and runes reflect standard Darius bruiser itemization from recent patches (Trinity Force into Black Cleaver into Sterak's Gage, Conqueror keystone); verify exact item and rune names against your current patch 16.18.1 since numbering and mythic-style items have shifted before.
